hypotheses.label: Local environmental or gravitational gradient between sites

hypotheses.label: External or synthetic data generation

hypotheses.label: Synthetic data generation applying programmatic site multiplier

hypotheses.label: Uncorrelated coincidence across independent instrument baselines
hypotheses.rationale: The correspondence to an exact 1.50 ratio could be a numerical coincidence resulting from independent calibration settings across four separate instruments.

beliefTimeline.summaryOfChange: Consolidated hypotheses around the consistent 1.50 ratio observed across Day 20 trials, slightly increasing weight on synthetic and DAQ explanations given continued precision of the 3:2 baseline offset.

hypotheses.label: Synthetic data generation artifact from an external simulation
